name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_open_reference_first_light_v1
description: Signal-only first-light observation from an independent disposable copy of the prepared Josef OPEN-window TestSetup00 reference. The owner reference is unchanged; no cannibal camp exists in this save, so this route proves physical light/smoke only.

steps.label: resume_saved_closed_room_world
steps.expected_visible_fact: Resume the exact saved task-owned TestSetup00 world without fixture installation or world replacement.

steps.label: no_fixture_install_on_saved_world_continuation
steps.expected_visible_fact: Registry continuation launches with no fixture declared; saved profile/world is already present.

steps.label: observe_open_reference_first_light
steps.objective: On the owner-prepared open-window world copy, use only ordinary native inventory selection to activate the charged lighter and choose the existing brazier tile. Verify actual burning fd_fire, retreat about two tiles without entering fire, and observe source-bound physical light and smoke over a bounded in-game window. The save has no cannibal camp, so this is signal-only.
proof_targets: same open-window reference copied into isolated task profile; source reference unchanged
safe mode OFF verified through advertised world.toggle_safemode before movement or wait
native lighter item selection and direction target
safe observation position about two tiles from fire
physical light and smoke channel/source records and event order
bounded elapsed in-game time and quicksave state
invariants: confirm safe mode OFF before movement or wait; toggle only if currently on
this owner reference contains no cannibal camp: make no cannibal admission/dispatch claim
quicksave at useful observation checkpoint and preserve saved copy

evidence_contract.claim: Ordinary lighter ignition in the disposable prepared open-window reference yields source-bound physical fire/light/smoke. The save has no cannibal camp, so no camp response claim is made.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No gameplay credit without exact source/profile/build binding, safe mode off, actual fire and source-bound physical signal evidence.
